attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file Kentucky corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus (post-Wayfair).

condition_details.condition_comment: Meets economic nexus threshold ($100K gross receipts or 200 transactions); result.ky_gross_receipts is greater than or equal to result.ky_economic_nexus_threshold

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Kentucky state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income. KY requires addback of federal interest income and IRC 199A deduction, with subtraction of KY municipal bond interest and dividends from KY corporations.

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Kentucky state additions and subtractions; Calculate state-specific income adjustments
action_details.action_dsl: set result.ky_state_additions = 0.0; if result.ky_us_interest_income != 0.0 then set result.ky_state_additions = result.ky_state_additions + result.ky_us_interest_income; endif set result.ky_state_subtractions = 0.0; if result.ky_municipal_interest != 0.0 then set result.ky_state_subtractions = result.ky_state_subtractions + result.ky_municipal_interest; endif if result.ky_dividends_from_ky_corps != 0.0 then set result.ky_state_subtractions = result.ky_state_subtractions + result.ky_dividends_from_ky_corps; endif add (("Kentucky additions: $" + string value of (result.ky_state_additions)) + ", subtractions: $") + string value of (result.ky_state_subtractions) to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvd /result.ky_state_additions xdef { result.ky_state_additions result.ky_us_interest_income f+ cvd /result.ky_state_additions xdef } {} result.ky_us_interest_income 0.0 f== not ifelse 0.0 cvd /result.ky_state_subtractions xdef { result.ky_state_subtractions result.ky_municipal_interest f+ cvd /result.ky_state_subtractions xdef } {} result.ky_municipal_interest 0.0 f== not ifelse { result.ky_state_subtractions result.ky_dividends_from_ky_corps f+ cvd /result.ky_state_subtractions xdef } {} result.ky_dividends_from_ky_corps 0.0 f== not ifelse "Kentucky additions: $" result.ky_state_additions cvs strconcat ", subtractions: $" strconcat result.ky_state_subtractions cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Kentucky corporate income tax. Applies Kentucky flat rate (4.5%) to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

condition_details.condition_comment: Has positive taxable income; result.ky_apportioned_income is greater than 0

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Kentucky corporate tax (flat rate 4.5%); Apply Kentucky 4.5% flat rate
action_details.action_dsl: set result.ky_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.ky_apportioned_income + result.ky_state_additions - result.ky_state_subtractions) and (0.0); set result.ky_tax_liability = the maximum of (result.ky_taxable_income * result.ky_corp_tax_rate - result.ky_state_credits) and (0.0); set result.ky_refund_or_owed = result.ky_estimated_payments - result.ky_tax_liability; add "Kentucky taxable income: $" + string value of (result.ky_taxable_income) to job.audit_trail; add "Kentucky tax liability (4.5%): $" + string value of (result.ky_tax_liability) to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: result.ky_apportioned_income result.ky_state_additions f+ result.ky_state_subtractions f- 0.0 fmax cvd /result.ky_taxable_income xdef result.ky_taxable_income result.ky_corp_tax_rate fmul result.ky_state_credits f- 0.0 fmax cvd /result.ky_tax_liability xdef result.ky_estimated_payments result.ky_tax_liability f- cvd /result.ky_refund_or_owed xdef "Kentucky taxable income: $" result.ky_taxable_income cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto "Kentucky tax liability (4.5%): $" result.ky_tax_liability cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No taxable income - no tax liability
